entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Enhanced navigation in .NET10: scroll happens before content renders, causing visual flash #64015
  • Investigate collecting Blazor specific runtime metrics from a Blazor WebAssembly app #64012
  • Some warnings "A preload for 'http://localhost:5215/_framework/blazor.webassembly.66stpp682q.js' is found, but is not used because the request credentials mode does not match" appear when running the 10.0 Blazor wasm Standalone app #64011
  • Blazor Web App WASM download performance issues #64009

  • IdentityPasskeyData.Name not persisted when using custom Guid keys #63923
    10.0
